# AMC High Contrast

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

An accessibility-first style: every text pair meets WCAG AAA (7:1), thick offset focus rings, underlined links, a visible border on every control, alerts marked by a thick start border and a symbol, and no shadows or gradients.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_high_contrast.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-high-contrast.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-high-contrast.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-high-contrast` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

| light | --ut-link-text-color on --ut-component-background-color | 10.11 | 4.5 |
| light | --ut-palette-primary-contrast on --ut-palette-primary | 10.11 | 4.5 |
| light | --ut-palette-primary on --ut-component-background-color | 10.11 | 3 |

Light style built on Vita for users who need strong contrast. All text pairs (body, region, muted, links, button text, badge text, alert text) are at least 7:1 (WCAG AAA). Focus is a 3px outline with a 2px offset (yellow inside the dark header). Links in content are underlined, controls have dark 1px borders, and shadows and gradients are removed. Alerts get a thick start border and, when the alert has no icon, a symbol before the title, so meaning is not carried by color alone. Report and badge refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
